posts.title: Elon Musk's Diary: Thursday, November 19th, 2026
posts.description: Inner weather report, filed from a hotel room in China. At DealBook, over video, Sorkin read back my old quote: my mind is a storm. Asked for today's conditions. Said "relatively at peace." Did not give the extended outlook. Humans say storm when they mean weather they cannot fix. On Mars, one lasted months and buried a rover called Opportunity. Mine buried Twitter. It came back as a letter. Both
